source.name: measured vapour pressures and the critical point
source.fit: 81 measured values (81 from the ThermoML Archive), 238.20-450.00 K, max deviation 6.3 %. No measured critical constants: the record covers the measured temperatures only. All the measured sets fitted together, each article with the same weight (no set preferred for a smaller stated uncertainty), pooled because they agree: each set lies within its mean stated uncertainty of the curve on average, except a narrow miss the maintainer accepted (2026-10-14): Wu 2019 (mean deviation -1.83 %, mean stated uncertainty 1.62 %); mean deviation of the fit from each set: Clara 2009 +0.86 %; Clara 2010 +2.58 %; Ngema 2012 -0.96 %; Stejfa 2014 +0.42 %; Wang 2014 -1.48 %; Wu 2019 -1.83 %. The largest deviations are at values whose stated uncertainty exceeds 10 % (7 values, 11-20 %); among the values stated within 10 %, the largest deviation is 3.2 %.
